start: Menu: Settings (address /settings), signed in as owner

steps.action: Open Settings
user_sees: Title "Settings"; tabs "Gym", "Member app" and "Sign-in & data"; on Gym the card "Gym details" (or "This branch’s details" with branches) with the name, "Phone", "GSTIN (optional)", "Address", "Gym UPI ID (optional)"
must_not: Another gym's or another branch's details in the boxes

steps.action: Change the phone and the address
user_sees: A hint under each box saying where members see it
must_not: The save button dead with no reason

steps.action: Tap the save button
user_sees: The new details kept after a reload; the new GSTIN on the next receipt; the new name in the header
must_not: Old receipts re-printed with the new GSTIN; the name changed here but not in the member app

steps.action: Tap "Member app"
user_sees: The card "Member app" with the gym's join code, "Your look in the app" (to Branding), "Challenges" and the other member-app choices
must_not: A join code of another gym

steps.action: Open Branding from "Your look in the app" and come back
user_sees: Settings again on the same tab
must_not: Back landing on the Gym tab

start: Settings, tab "Sign-in & data": records, backup, and the admin app on your phone

steps.action: Tap "Sign-in & data"
user_sees: "Staff & sign-in", "Download a backup", "Your gym’s records" with how many members, memberships, payments and check-ins are saved and "Set up {day}", and when the terms were accepted
must_not: Counts that differ from the Members and Money pages

steps.action: Tap the button under "Download a backup"
user_sees: One Excel file of all the gym's data is saved to this device
must_not: A file with rows missing; a file sent anywhere other than this device

steps.action: Use the card that puts the admin app on this phone
user_sees: The browser's own "add to home screen" step, or plain words on how to do it on this phone
must_not: A button that does nothing on an iPhone; the old web address installed

steps.action: Tap "Import members from Excel"
user_sees: The import page
must_not: An import started with no file

start: Wrong values in "Gym details", and no internet

steps.action: Type a UPI ID with no @
user_sees: An error on the UPI box; nothing saved
must_not: A wrong UPI ID saved and then put into fee messages to members

steps.action: Type a GSTIN of the wrong length
user_sees: Refused in plain words, or saved as typed (which one was not read)
must_not: A wrong GSTIN printed on receipts with no warning

steps.action: Clear the gym name and save
user_sees: Refused: a gym needs a name
must_not: A gym with an empty name in the header and in the member app

steps.action: Turn the internet off and change the gym name
user_sees: A plain word that it cannot be saved now, or that it will be sent later
must_not: "Saved" shown while the member app keeps the old name for good

start: Erase or start over (a gym kept only in this browser), and the "Danger zone" of an online gym

steps.action: Browser-only gym: tap "Load demo gym"
user_sees: A question first; after yes, the demo gym with its own details in the boxes
must_not: The real gym's records erased with no question; the old gym's UPI ID left in the demo gym's boxes

steps.action: Tap "Erase and start fresh"
user_sees: A question that says it cannot be undone; after yes, an empty gym
must_not: An online gym's records wiped from here

steps.action: Demo gym connected to the shop: "Start over with a new demo gym"
user_sees: A question first; a new demo gym
must_not: This button shown for a real gym

steps.action: Real gym with the shop on: "Disconnect the shop"
user_sees: A question first; after yes every member and payment is still here
must_not: Members or payments lost by disconnecting

steps.action: Online gym: scroll to "Danger zone: this can’t be undone"
user_sees: No erase and no demo buttons; a way to ask MettleUp to delete the gym, and a separate block to clear the offline copy on this device
must_not: The gym deleted at once from the panel; "clear offline copy" touching the records online

steps.action: A gym this browser could not read
user_sees: "A gym this browser couldn’t read is kept here." and "Download the saved data"
must_not: The unreadable gym thrown away

start: The gym's data: copy, delete, and who can do it

steps.action: Download the backup
user_sees: The file holds members' names and phone numbers: it is now on this device, in the owner's care
must_not: The download offered to the front desk

steps.action: Ask for the gym to be deleted
user_sees: The request goes to MettleUp, which deletes step by step; the panel says what happens next
must_not: Records deleted with no way to get a copy first

steps.action: Read the privacy notice
user_sees: You can ask for a copy of your data and ask to correct or delete it
must_not: A copy that leaves out a kind of data the gym keeps

start: Menu: Settings, signed in as front desk

steps.action: Open Settings
user_sees: Title "Settings", under it "Screen colours, app and your sign-in"; cards "Dark or light", "Members" with "Import members from Excel", the desk person's own sign-in card, the card to put the app on this phone, and alerts for this device
must_not: Gym details, the join code, Branding, the backup or the Danger zone

steps.action: Switch "Dark or light"
user_sees: The app changes colour at once
must_not: The owner's device changing too

steps.action: Sign out from the sign-in card
user_sees: The sign-in page
must_not: Still signed in on reload

steps.action: Type /settings/branding or /settings/mettleup
user_sees: "Only an owner can see this" with "Back to Today"
must_not: The Branding or the Pay MettleUp page

steps.action: Type /settings/data or another tab address
user_sees: The desk's own Settings page
must_not: The owner's tabs

start: What the desk cannot do in Settings

steps.action: Look for a way to change the gym name, phone, GSTIN or UPI ID
user_sees: None
must_not: A box the desk can type in; a save that the server then refuses with a raw error

steps.action: Look for "Download a backup", "Load demo gym", "Erase and start fresh"
user_sees: None
must_not: Any of them, greyed or not

steps.action: Turn the internet off and tap "Import members from Excel"
user_sees: The button says it needs the internet
must_not: An import that starts and fails half-way

start: The desk's own choices over time

steps.action: Switch to Light, reload
user_sees: Still Light
must_not: Back to Dark after a reload

steps.action: Turn alerts on for this device, then off
user_sees: One state shown; no alert after off
must_not: Alerts still arriving after off

steps.action: Sign out, sign in again
user_sees: The same Settings page; the theme as left
must_not: Another person's sign-in card

start: The gym's data and the desk

steps.action: Open every part of Settings as front desk
user_sees: No download of all gym data, no records count, no delete
must_not: The whole member list leaving the gym on a desk person's device by a button

steps.action: Note for the audit: the gym's records are still loaded onto the desk device for everyday work (the code says so itself)
user_sees: Nothing on screen
must_not: A backup or export button for the desk
